texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.UsdCnyRate: Decimal string, e.g. 7.2. WeChat/Alipay quotes multiply the USD amount by this rate.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.ValidityMinut: Minimum 15 minutes. A shorter window only shrinks the time a stale rate can be paid.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.Wechat.Settle: Decimal fraction of the pay amount settled, used in the X_min formula.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.Wechat.FixedF: Decimal fraction applied to the fixed fee in the X_min formula.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.Alipay.Settle: Decimal fraction of the pay amount settled, used in the X_min formula.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.Alipay.FixedF: Decimal fraction applied to the fixed fee in the X_min formula.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.Stripe.FixedF: Decimal string in USD, at least 0.30.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.Stripe.Settle: Decimal fraction of the pay amount settled, used in the X_min formula.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.Stripe.FixedF: Decimal fraction applied to the fixed fee in the X_min formula.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.BalanceUsdt.S: Decimal fraction used in the X_min formula.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.BalanceUsdt.F: Decimal fraction applied to the fixed fee in the X_min formula.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.BalanceUsdc.S: Decimal fraction used in the X_min formula.
texts.Description:Ordering.Quote.BalanceUsdc.F: Decimal fraction applied to the fixed fee in the X_min formula.
